items.title: File Einspruch against tax assessment
items.quote: Legen Sie ihn innerhalb eines Monats ab Bekanntgabe beim Finanzamt Musterwolgast ein, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Letter dated (Bescheid vom) 20.11.2026 (Friday); no separate posting date stated, so posting day = 20.11.2026. Per § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO, a letter posted on/after 1 Jan 2025 is deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting: 20.11 (day0,Fri) +1=21.11(Sat) +2=22.11(Sun) +3=23.11(Mon) +4=24.11(Tue) -> deemed delivery 24.11.2026. This 4th day is a Tuesday (not Sat/Sun/holiday), so no shift under § 108 Abs. 3 AO is needed. The one-month Einspruch period (§ 355 Abs. 1 AO, §§ 187 Abs.1/188 Abs.2 BGB) runs from the day after delivery and ends on the day in the following month bearing the same number as the delivery day: 24.11.2026 + 1 month = 24.12.2026 (Thursday). 24 December is a statutory working day in Germany, so no further adjustment under § 108 Abs. 3 AO applies. Final deadline: 24.12.2026.
